title: Technology Risk Manager
description: We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM. Position Summary RSM is seeking a Temporary Supervisor with 6+ years of experience in analytics and data engineering to support Risk Consulting engagements in the Financial Services and Global Banking sectors. This is a build role. Working under the pod's Senior Analytics Engineer, this individual constructs the foundation layers of a regulatory reporting analytics platform: cycle-scoped data acquisition, an immutable as-filed snapshot vault, the canonical data model, and the exception and data-gap findings store. Key Responsibilities Build cycle-scoped acquisition and staging routines over client-provided extracts, with no transformation in the landing layer. Build the as-filed snapshot vault - immutable and append-only, keyed on reporting cycle and record identifier - so that a prior cycle can be reproduced exactly as filed. Build the canonical data model together with its reference and product-to-classification mapping tables. Build the exception and data-gap findings store, including disposition state, so that each exception carries its rule version, its run, and the source records behind it. Implement the rule-run instrumentation and run logs that make each analytics cycle reproducible. Implement data quality controls, validation and reconciliation, including reconciliation of loaded data back to filed regulatory totals. Perform data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and issue remediation across complex data environments. Document data lineage and control evidence to the standard required for audit and regulatory review. Build supporting datasets for the Power BI reporting layer in partnership with the BI Engineer. Support risk, compliance, regulatory reporting, and audit-related data initiatives, and participate in SIT, UAT, documentation, implementation and production support activities. Required Qualifications 6+ years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or data warehouse development. This role builds and maintains data structures; it is not a governance or business analysis role. Strong SQL, including complex transformation logic, performance tuning, and reconciliation queries. Experience with ETL/ELT tooling and data integration across multiple source systems. Experience with dimensional and canonical data modeling, including slowly changing and point-in-time or snapshot patterns. Experience working within Financial Services, Banking, Risk Management, Compliance, or Regulatory Reporting environments. Experience implementing data quality controls and reconciliation in a regulated environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of BCBS 239, regulatory reporting, risk data aggregation, or enterprise risk programs. Experience building immutable or append-only historical stores, and reconstructing prior reporting periods. Experience with data lineage and metadata documentation, and with tools such as Collibra. Working knowledge of Power BI as the consumption layer over a canonical model. Experience with Azure, Databricks, Synapse, Fabric, or other modern cloud analytics platforms. Technology Stack The client's target platform is confirmed during discovery. Experience with any of Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, Fabric, Informatica, Talend, Alteryx or Teradata is relevant; SQL, dimensional and canonical data modeling, and Power BI are the constants. Depth in these fundamentals matters more than experience with any specific technology stack. Engagement Details Client: a large US bank. The role is embedded in the client's regulatory compliance function. Program: build-out of a regulatory reporting analytics capability - as-filed snapshot layer, canonical loan model, a rules and analytics engine, an exception store, and Power BI reporting. Location: hybrid, Charlotte NC or Atlanta GA. Onshore US only; Eastern time zone hours. No visa sponsorship and no offshore delivery on this engagement. Must successfully complete all third-party risk onboarding requirements. Client onboarding (background screening, third-party risk, badging and VDI access) runs three to four weeks and is on the critical path - candidates must be available to begin onboarding immediately upon selection. The Team Pinterest's Shopping & Delivery Infrastructure team builds and operates the catalog, indexing, retrieval, and serving systems that power Shopping and ads across every Pinterest surface, from search and homefeed to P2P and international markets. Our mission is to make Pinterest's shopping and delivery stack unified, scalable, and low-latency so we can drive sustainable revenue growth, exceptional Pinner experiences, and measurable advertiser outcomes. Build and maintain program dashboards and reporting that give engineering and cross-functional stakeholders a clear view of progress, risk, and decisions. Manage cross-team dependencies with partner teams across catalog, indexing, retrieval, serving, and ads quality. Communicate clearly in writing and verbally across Use GenAI as the default operating model for EP PgM execution—producing AI-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, modernizing high-toil workflows into AI-first mechanisms (e.g., intake triage, status synthesis, action/decision extraction, risk & dependency tracking), and synthesizing signals to proactively surface risks, decision/trade-offs, and escalation paths. Prototype solutions to augment decisions through data (e.g. dashboards, data analysis) or simplify processes (e.g. process and workflow helpers, or internal tools) using AI coding assistants (“vibe coding”). Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance, and safety-by-design: appropriately handle sensitive data, validate AI-generated outputs, document assumptions/limits, and ensure AI-assisted workflows meet applicable policy/compliance expectations before broad adoption.   What We're Looking For 2–4 years of TPM experience independently driving technical programs to completion, ideally within infrastructure, platform, or data-adjacent environments. Solid foundational understanding of distributed systems concepts — services, streaming pipelines, batch vs real-time processing. Strong execution and follow-through, with a track record of running multiple concurrent workstreams without dropping the ball. Comfortable working with data — building dashboards, tracking metrics, and turning progress into clear status updates. Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations. Experience with ads, monetization, streaming systems (Flink/Kafka), or financial-controls processes is a plus; willingness to learn the domain is essential. Workflow design, AI fluency, data & insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms and improving decision-making by using GenAI (e.g., strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts/tools, dashboards, data analysis and leveraging agents where appropriate) Safety-by-design AI fluency: experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, data handling, model/output validation, auditability/traceability) and proactively identifying where AI use is not appropriate or requires additional controls.
